youtube.title: Why Goethe was so embarrassed by Beethoven 🎩 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Ludwig van Beethoven and Goethe went for a walk. Then the Empress showed up. 🎩👑

Goethe bowed. Beethoven kept his hat on and walked straight through the royals.

Would you have bowed? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on the famous 1812 meeting in Teplitz (Bohemia), the summer Beethoven finished his 8th Symphony. Goethe later wrote that Beethoven was "an utterly untamed personality".

#beethoven #ludwigvanbeethoven #goethe #classicalmusic #historymemes #history #shorts
